subject: Kan niet inloggen
reason: This is a standard how-to question regarding a forgotten password, fully answered by F01. Priority is P4 as the help centre provides a self-service solution.
draft_reply:
Hoi Marloes,

Je kunt een nieuw wachtwoord instellen via app.roosterly.nl/login. Klik daar op "Wachtwoord vergeten" en vul je e-mailadres in. Je ontvangt dan een resetlink die 60 minuten geldig is. Zie je geen e-mail binnen 10 minuten? Controleer dan voor de zekerheid je spambox.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hi Marloes,

You can reset your password via app.roosterly.nl/login. Click on "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password) and enter your email address. You will receive a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes. If you don't receive an email within 10 minutes, please check your spam folder.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hi Marloes, You can set a new password via app.roosterly.nl/login. Click "Wachtwoord vergeten" there and enter your email address. You will then receive a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes. Don't see an email within 10 minutes? Then be sure to check your spam folder. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Export naar Loket
reason: The customer asks about exporting hours to Loket.nl. F04 and F05 fully answer this, noting that payroll integrations like Loket.nl require the Plus plan and how to upgrade from Basis.
draft_reply:
Hallo,

Ja, Roosterly kan goedgekeurde uren exporteren naar Loket.nl. De koppling met Loket.nl maakt onderdeel uit van het Plus-abonnement. Je kunt de koppeling instellen onder Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll).

Als je momenteel het Basis-abonnement hebt, kun je op elk moment upgraden naar Plus via Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). De nieuwe prijs geldt vanaf de volgende factuur.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello,

Yes, Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. The integration with Loket.nl is part of the Plus plan. You can set this up under Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll).

If you currently have the Basis plan, you can upgrade to Plus at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, Yes, Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. The integration with Loket.nl is part of the Plus plan. You can set up the integration under Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll). If you currently have the Basis plan, you can upgrade to Plus at any time via Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Schichten tauschen
reason: The ticket is a standard how-to question about shift swapping, which is fully answered by FAQ F03. Priority is P4 (how-to question).
draft_reply:
Hallo,

Mitarbeiter öffnen die Schicht in der App und tippen auf "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit derselben Rolle können den Tausch annehmen. Die Führungskraft genehmigt ihn unter Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Die Genehmigung durch die Führungskraft ist standardmäßig aktiviert; Sie können sie unter Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota) ausschalten.

Viele Grüße
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello,

Employees open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is on by default; you can turn it off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, Employees open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is on by default; you can turn it off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota). Kind regards, Team Roosterly
